title: Wanted full time helper for new born in August
label: childcare

posts.body:
Just taking the chance that one of you have come across someone good that perhaps didnt meet your specific requirements. We need a full time, live in helper who will be primarily looking after the baby as both my husband and I work full time. This will be our first baby.

Am looking for some one with very good references and experience with new born. We can sign right away!
